SELECT id, name, price, quantity, category FROM product WHERE name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{name}, '%')
SELECT id, name, price, quantity, category FROM product WHERE category = #{category}
SELECT id, name, price, quantity, category FROM product WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO product (id, name, price, quantity, category) VALUES (#{id}, #{name}, #{price}, #{quantity}, #{category})
mapper.update: UPDATE product SET quantity = quantity + #{amount} WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE product SET quantity = quantity - #{amount} WHERE id = #{id} AND quantity >= #{amount}
mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT category FROM product WHERE category IS NOT NULL
